# Bold Portfolio Hero

**ID:** bold-portfolio-hero
**Category:** Portfolio
**Type:** hero
**License:** Free

---

## Full Prompt

```
Build a bold single-viewport portfolio hero for a motion designer: a near-black stage, an oversized variable sans headline set as two lines, one accent word in vermilion, and a 16:10 showreel that starts muted and only plays while in view. Add a slim top bar with a name mark and three links, a one-line availability status with a green dot, and a bottom row of four monogram logos. Include a magnetic pointer effect on the primary button that stops at a 6px pull, keyboard focus rings, reduced-motion fallbacks that freeze the reel, and no layout shift while the fonts swap.
```
